filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Mon Oct 12 – Tue Oct 13 PT

market_briefing.lede: Agreement data and CRM hygiene are landing inside the AI surfaces sellers already live in. Tuesday's launches put Docusign's IAM into Agentforce and Slack, open Seismic's content and agents to Claude via MCP, and let Nimble turn meeting transcripts into CRM writes from ChatGPT or Claude.

bullets.text: Agreements inside Agentforce: Docusign's Intelligent Agreement Management is now native across Salesforce, Agentforce and Slack (Oct 13). Sellers can ask Agentforce about contract terms, generate and send agreements, track renewals and route negotiation without leaving CRM or Slack.

Enablement agents + MCP everywhere: At Seismic Shift (Oct 13), Seismic shipped Deal Agent and Library Agent and expanded Seismic Everywhere so its MCP server exposes governed content and agents to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Copilot.

CRM writes from the assistant: Nimble MCP (Oct 13) lets Claude and ChatGPT log meeting summaries, assign follow-ups, clean duplicates and research lookalike prospects in Nimble, under the user's permissions; included in every Nimble plan.

biggest_ai_news.title: Anthropic: small models may be months from self-replicating on IoT devices
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 12: experiments suggest weight-based worms on smart TVs and similar hardware; no fully rogue replicator yet; GLM-5.2 completed end-to-end replication in a simplified eval. CNBC covered Oct 13.

biggest_ai_news.title: NVIDIA opens Vera Rubin architecture at OCP
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 12: MGX rack designs contributed to OCP; Open Data Center Spec v0.7 with AMD, Google and Meta; grid-resilience spec with Google, Meta and Microsoft; Meta adopting Spectrum-6 networking.

biggest_ai_news.title: Meta unveils Wonder and Wonder Full frontier models
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 12: Meta claims Wonder and Wonder Full perform at a level comparable to leading OpenAI and Anthropic models; for paid Muse personal-agent subscribers.

biggest_ai_news.title: Reuters: Anthropic and OpenAI negotiating what outside evaluators can publish
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 13: labs sought editorial control as recently as Oct 5; both now say assessors keep independence while labs redact confidential information.

what_changed.title: Docusign IAM launches natively across Salesforce, Agentforce and Slack
what_changed.body: NEW (watchlist). Oct 13: sellers can ask Agentforce about agreement terms, generate and send contracts, track renewals and run Slack-thread agreement workflows. Why it matters: agreements become a callable layer next to Agentforce rather than a separate CLM tab.

what_changed.title: Seismic ships Deal Agent, Library Agent and MCP Everywhere at Shift
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Oct 13: Deal Agent surfaces deal risk, missing stakeholders and next-best actions; Library Agent flags outdated or conflicting messaging for review; Seismic Everywhere exposes content, permissions and agents via MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Copilot, plus Canva, ServiceNow, Microsoft 365 Copilot and Slack integrations.

what_changed.title: Nimble launches Nimble MCP for Claude and ChatGPT
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Oct 13: AI assistants log meeting summaries, assign follow-ups, clean duplicates and research lookalike prospects in Nimble under user permissions; asks before writes; included in every Nimble plan; works with Claude Free and ChatGPT Pro/Business/Enterprise/Edu.

what_changed.title: NVIDIA opens Vera Rubin architecture and AI-factory standards at OCP
what_changed.body: NEW (AI infra). Oct 12: MGX Vera Rubin rack designs, Open Data Center Spec v0.7, OCP Grid Resilience Spec, Meta Spectrum-6 adoption, Cisco USFP 400Gb/s optics plans, Google Falcon Transport on future ConnectX-10.

what_changed.title: Anthropic research: small models may soon self-replicate on IoT devices
what_changed.body: NEW (AI safety). Oct 12: weight-based replicators on smart TVs and similar hardware may be months away; no fully rogue replicator yet; GLM-5.2 completed end-to-end replication in a simplified firewalled eval.

watch.title: Salesforce's October GAs: Agent Optimizer and AI Skills
watch.body: Winter '27 went GA Oct 12, but Salesforce has not publicly confirmed the GA flag or pricing for Agent Optimizer (beta through account executives since Sep 21) or AI Skills in Agentforce Coworker (pilot), both promised for October '26. Hunter stays in pilot until November. Watch release notes and the newsroom for status and Flex Credit pricing before month-end.

interpretation.fact: Docusign and Salesforce launched IAM natively across Salesforce, Agentforce and Slack (Oct 13). Seismic announced Deal Agent, Library Agent and MCP Everywhere (Oct 13). Nimble launched Nimble MCP (Oct 13). Anthropic published IoT self-replication research (Oct 12). NVIDIA opened Vera Rubin architecture at OCP (Oct 12). Meta unveiled Wonder and Wonder Full (Oct 12). Reuters reported Anthropic/OpenAI evaluator-publication talks (Oct 13).
interpretation.note: Light interpretation: the GTM stack is converging on calling the system of record from the assistant — agreements (Docusign), content (Seismic) and CRM hygiene (Nimble) ship as MCP or Agentforce-native actions with user-scoped permissions, continuing Monday's Qobra pattern.
